verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents a built-in AI Support Assistant in the dashboard's troubleshooting area. It uses Fivetran documentation and known solutions to help resolve common issues without a human support engineer, so it is an in-product assistant but only for support and troubleshooting help. The MCP server and the coding-agent plugins run in external agents and are not built-in, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: evidence the assistant can carry out delegated actions in the product (creating or modifying connections, running syncs or transformations), scope beyond support troubleshooting, availability details beyond Free/Standard plans, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: The assistant uses Fivetran documentation and known solutions to help resolve common issues quickly, without waiting for a human support engineer.
For users on Free and Standard plans, it is the first point of contact before opening a support ticket.
